## [1.4.0](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-31)

### Bug Fixes

* hide creator sponsorships in native and React Native players ([e14935a](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/e14935ac02abe76262e1f62a2e59744a0b6b65ca))
* keep React Native hooks on the packaged bundle ([9f4857c](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/9f4857c49d7e168b4430a954e5d00c9b6b0f43d4))
* preserve background playback preferences on DJ streams ([b63f31d](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/b63f31d6326593036d73963a45c5af01a1a997ca))
* restore DJ background playback and update Twitch targets ([7d4bed3](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/7d4bed3e89217a5c3f3f77e797a446d0782de078))
* start preroll backup preparation without delay ([2819663](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/281966306bcbb7ed8e17aa404b0ac829c2209d86))
* suspend emote draft rendering while Twitch is paused ([ef0128b](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/ef0128b314d5c736bc49e24f028bc375e661f550))

### Features

* add external emote autocomplete and draft previews ([4ce1fc7](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/4ce1fc74d4ff3ba50171fb00b48cf6f419af19ed))

### App Support

* verify Twitch 31.8.0 and 31.9.0 beta compatibility ([752b79e](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/752b79e8ba4e53e512d250b9d3de31aca8a4a162))

patches.name: Auto-claim bonus channel points
patches.description: Automatically claims bonus channel points while watching live streams.

patches.name: BTTV, FFZ and 7TV emotes
patches.description: Adds global and channel emotes to chat, autocomplete and the emote picker, with animations and input previews.

patches.name: Block client-requested ads
patches.description: Blocks native player ad requests. Restart Twitch after changing this setting.

patches.name: Block stream ads
patches.description: Replaces detected preroll and midroll ads with direct Twitch playback.

patches.name: Hide Turbo promotions
patches.description: Hides Twitch Turbo promotions and purchase prompts.

patches.name: Hide feed and display ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored feed cards, banners and display ads.

patches.name: Hide subscription discount banners
patches.description: Hides subscription offers, discount banners and promotional labels.

patches.name: Inspect Twitch APK
patches.description: Reports the APK package, version and DEX class count without modifying the app.

patches.name: Playback diagnostics
patches.description: Records playlist metadata and playback counters for troubleshooting.

patches.name: Reload stream
patches.description: Reloads live streams with a double-tap control.

patches.name: Show deleted messages
patches.description: Reveals deleted and moderated chat messages on tap.

patches.name: UI settings
patches.description: Customizes player controls, channel actions, extensions, Hype Trains, leaderboards and fullscreen system bars.
